# اِقْتَرَعْتَ (iqtaraʕta) /iq.ta.raʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# اِقْتَرَعْتِ (iqtaraʕti) /iq.ta.raʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# اِقْتَرَعَتْ (iqtaraʕat) /iq.ta.ra.ʕat/: third-perso
